title: Half-Life Medkit Totem
description: Replaces Totem of Undying with a medkit from Half-Life 1. Also retextures Evokers to look like scientists.
body: The Totem of Undying has been replaced with model of a medkit from Half-Life 1. The particles were made invisible, the screen obscuring animation removed and the sound of totem popping was also replaced with the medkit sound effect from Half-Life 1. The Evokers were retextured to look like Half-Life 1 science personnel, their vex summon sound effect also has been replaced with teleportation sound from Half-Life 1.
